protocolUtilities.constraint.conflicting: These attributes must be both equal and different. Remove one of the conflicting rules.
protocolUtilities.constraint.disjointBou: The comparisons between these attributes cannot fit within their allowed ranges. Adjust the ranges or comparisons.
protocolUtilities.constraint.disjointOpt: These attributes must share one value, but their available options have no value in common. Add a common option or change the equality rule.
protocolUtilities.constraint.drawExhaust: No value satisfies these rules alongside the values already chosen for related attributes. Review the related rules or try another generation seed.
protocolUtilities.constraint.duplicateFi: The same value is assigned to multiple nodes or links, but the value must be unique. Change the fixed values or the uniqueness rule.
protocolUtilities.constraint.emptyDateRa: The earliest permitted date is after the latest permitted date. Correct the date range.
protocolUtilities.constraint.fixedComple: The fixed values assigned by a question leave no valid values for the remaining attributes. Change the fixed values or the related comparison rules.
protocolUtilities.constraint.fixedValueR: The assigned fixed values conflict with these validation rules. Change the fixed values or the conflicting rules.
protocolUtilities.constraint.incompatibl: Forms use incompatible input controls for the same attribute. Use controls that allow a common set of values.
protocolUtilities.constraint.inheritance: Narrative pedigree stages assign different inheritance patterns to the same disease attribute. Use a consistent inheritance pattern.
protocolUtilities.constraint.insufficien: Too few distinct values are available for all the nodes or links this protocol can create. Allow more values or change the uniqueness rule.
protocolUtilities.constraint.invertedBou: The minimum exceeds the maximum, so no answer is allowed. Adjust these limits.
protocolUtilities.constraint.minSelected: The minimum selection exceeds the number of available options. Add options or reduce the minimum.
protocolUtilities.constraint.negativeSel: A negative maximum selection permits no answer. Set a maximum of zero or more.
protocolUtilities.constraint.negativeTex: A negative maximum text length permits no answer. Set a maximum of zero or more.
protocolUtilities.constraint.noSolution: No combination of permitted values satisfies all these rules. Review the rules for the listed attributes.
protocolUtilities.constraint.numberDateC: A number is compared with a date. Use attributes with compatible types for this comparison.
protocolUtilities.constraint.oddDifferen: There are too few allowed values to make all the required attributes different. Add allowed values or remove a conflicting rule.
protocolUtilities.constraint.pedigreeFix: A validation rule rejects a fixed value required by the family pedigree data model. Adjust the rule to permit the required value.
protocolUtilities.constraint.pinnedDiffe: The fixed values and rules requiring different answers cannot all be satisfied. Change a fixed value or a comparison.
protocolUtilities.constraint.pinnedEqual: These attributes must differ, but their rules force the same value. Widen a range or change a comparison.
protocolUtilities.constraint.requiredEmp: The maximum selection is zero, but an answer is required. Allow at least one selection or make the answer optional.
The maximum text length is zero, but an answer is required. Allow text or make the answer optional.
protocolUtilities.constraint.sameAsGroup: These attributes must share one value, but their permitted values or date resolutions are incompatible. Align their rules and input controls.
protocolUtilities.constraint.sharedBound: These attributes must share one value, but their allowed ranges do not overlap. Adjust the ranges or the equality rule.
protocolUtilities.constraint.strictCompa: These attributes reference each other in an impossible comparison cycle. Change a comparison to break the cycle.
protocolUtilities.constraint.textGenerat: The minimum text length exceeds the size a generated value can hold. Reduce the minimum length.
protocolUtilities.constraint.uniqueEgo: Unique values are not supported for participant attributes. Remove this validation rule.
